about: Images built by stc-compiler for the language/device matrix's N1 (Z80 C) and N4 (hosted ARM assembly), so tests can run them on the pinned bw-board engines with no network. z80: the z80-pd-bench example's program.bw emitted by generateC and compiled by /compile target z80 (format bin); the test re-emits the C and fails on drift. stm32f030/rp2040: the `source` assembled by /assemble (Intel HEX).

stm32f030-blink.source:
@ STM32F030: toggle PA5 forever (the Nucleo LED pin).
    .syntax unified
    .cpu cortex-m0
    .thumb
    .section .vectors, "a"
    .word 0x20001000          @ initial SP: top of 4 KB SRAM
    .word reset + 1           @ reset handler (Thumb)
    .text
    .thumb_func
reset:
    ldr r0, =0x40021014       @ RCC_AHBENR
    ldr r1, [r0]
    ldr r2, =0x00020000       @ IOPAEN
    orrs r1, r2
    str r1, [r0]
    ldr r0, =0x48000000       @ GPIOA_MODER
    ldr r1, [r0]
    ldr r2, =0x00000400       @ MODER5 = 01 (output)
    orrs r1, r2
    str r1, [r0]
    ldr r0, =0x48000014       @ GPIOA_ODR
    movs r3, #0x20            @ bit 5
loop:
    ldr r1, [r0]
    eors r1, r3
    str r1, [r0]
    ldr r4, =20000
delay:
    subs r4, #1
    bne delay
    b loop

rp2040-blink.source:
@ RP2040: toggle GP25 (the Pico LED) through SIO, from SRAM.
    .syntax unified
    .cpu cortex-m0plus
    .thumb
    .text
    .global main
    .thumb_func
main:
    ldr r0, =0x400140cc       @ IO_BANK0 GPIO25_CTRL
    movs r1, #5               @ FUNCSEL = SIO
    str r1, [r0]
    ldr r0, =0xd0000000       @ SIO base
    ldr r1, =0x02000000       @ bit 25
    str r1, [r0, #0x24]       @ GPIO_OE_SET
loop:
    str r1, [r0, #0x1c]       @ GPIO_OUT_XOR
    ldr r2, =20000
delay:
    subs r2, #1
    bne delay
    b loop
